$comment: CUSTOMER CARDS (PlateUp's): on a card day, one of these is offered beside a recipe card, and the players choose one of the two. A card changes the guests for the rest of the run; it's never offered twice in a run. Effects: moods {mood: chance} -- the chance (0-1) a guest has that mood (impatient, relaxed: patience; messy: tidiness), rolled in this file's order, last roll wins within a track; guests -- extra guests every day; tip -- coins on top of every dish served (negative: less). Word the text as 'X% chance a guest is Y'.

cards.label: Impatient crowd
cards.text: 40% chance a guest is impatient. Every guest tips 1 more.

cards.label: Messy crowd
cards.text: 30% chance a guest is messy. Every guest tips 1 more.

cards.label: Affordable
cards.text: Every dish pays 1 less. 2 more guests every day.

cards.label: Relaxed, but busy
cards.text: 2 more guests every day. 40% chance a guest is relaxed.

cards.label: Hasty lunch
cards.text: 25% chance a guest is impatient. 1 more guest every day. Every guest tips 2 more.
